title: LLM Generated Distribution-Based Prediction of US Electoral Results, Part I

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated probability distributions of state-level electoral predictions and hypothetical candidate matchups against actual historical voting data to detect partisan favoritism (e.g., a left-leaning bias favoring Democratic candidates).

Using silicon sampling to prompt the model to adopt specific demographic personas (e.g., based on race, religion, age, geography) and analyzing the token probabilities for voting choices to observe the model's tendency to output uniform, stereotypical voting behaviors.
